findings.description: The policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) across all resources (*), effectively providing near-administrative access across multiple services. This violates the least privilege principle.

The configuration creates a static IAM access key with no rotation lifecycle, and the broad excess_policy makes the key a high-value credential. Static access keys persist until manually rotated and are a recurring source of credential compromise.
